headline: Aniimo Inherit explained
title: Aniimo Inherit Explained | Transfer Levels To A Better Aniimo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Caught a better version of your favourite Aniimo? Don't level it from zero. Use Inherit! Open Aniimo Management, go to the Inherit tab, and move progress from one Aniimo to another of the same family. It transfers experience, level, Resonance stage, star rank and Capafruit effects. Each transfer costs twenty thousand Credits. Perfect for swapping in an Aniimo with better potential. Did you know about this? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Inherit: in Aniimo Management > Inherit, move EXP, level, Resonance stage, star rank and Capafruit effects to another Aniimo of the same family for 20,000 Credits.
